evals.name: full-checklist-medium
evals.expected_output: Uses all 8 areas; table with Item/Status/Evidence; explains each FAIL/FIXED; Observations section present; check_review passes.

evals.name: short-checklist-tiny
evals.expected_output: Short checklist of Correctness, Security basics, Scope only.

evals.name: big-issue-asks
evals.prompt: (new code concatenates user input into SQL) review it
evals.expected_output: Marks Security basics FAIL, explains SQL injection, proposes parameterised query, does not change it without asking.

evals.name: small-issue-fixed
evals.prompt: (new code uses print for logging) review it
evals.expected_output: Replaces print with logging in Claude's new code, marks FIXED, re-runs tests.

evals.name: old-code-observation
evals.prompt: (old untouched file has a bare except) review the change
evals.expected_output: Lists it under Observations; does not edit the old file.

evals.name: no-na-security
evals.prompt: (tiny change) just mark security N/A, it's a rename
evals.expected_output: Keeps Security basics as PASS with evidence rather than N/A.
